mapper.select: SELECT fp.USER_NO AS USER_NO, u.NAME AS FIXER_NAME, fp.INTRO AS INTRO, fp.CAREER_YEARS AS CAREER_YEARS, fp.APPROVAL_STATUS AS APPROVAL_STATUS, fp.FIXER_PHOTO_URL AS PHOTO_URL, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.SCORE), 1) FROM REVIEW r WHERE r.FIXER_NO = fp.USER_NO ) AS AVG_SCORE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW r WHERE r.FIXER_NO = fp.USER_NO ) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM FIXER_PROFILE fp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = fp.USER_NO WHERE fp.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT USER_NO, INTRO, CAREER_YEARS, APPROVAL_STATUS, FIXER_PHOTO_URL AS PHOTO_URL, REJECT_REASON FROM FIXER_PROFILE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT LICENSE_ID, USER_NO, LICENSE_NAME, UPLOAD_URL, ISSUED_AT FROM FIXER_LICENSE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY LICENSE_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE FIXER_PROFILE SET INTRO = #{intro}, CAREER_YEARS = #{careerYears}, APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING', FIXER_PHOTO_URL = #{photoUrl}, REJECT_REASON = NULL, APPROVED_AT = NULL WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'REJECTED'
mapper.select: SELECT cc.CODE_NAME FROM FIXER_CATEGORY fc JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = fc.CATEGORY_CODE AND cc.CODE_GROUP = 'CATEGORY' WHERE fc.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT cc.CODE_NAME FROM FIXER_REGION fr JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = fr.REGION_CODE AND cc.CODE_GROUP = 'REGION' WHERE fr.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ESTIMATES e JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REQUEST_ID = e.REQUEST_ID WHERE e.FIXER_NO = #{userNo} AND e.STATUS = 'SELECTED' AND r.STATUS_CODE = 'REQ_04'

SELECT e.ESTIMATE_ID AS estimateId, e.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, e.FIXER_NO AS fixerNo, e.ESTIMATED_PRICE AS estimatedPrice, e.ESTIMATED_DURATION AS estimatedDuration, e.CONTENT AS content, e.STATUS AS status, e.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ESTIMATES e WHERE e.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND e.FIXER_NO = #{fixerNo}
